lines.zh: 嗡鸣振翅，密室深处潜行。
lines.en: Buzzing wings, creeping deep in the hive.
Wings fluttering, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 嗡嗡低鸣，穿梭于蜂巢之间。
lines.en: Buzzing softly, darting through the hive.

lines.zh: 触须轻摆，探索周围环境。
lines.en: Antennae swaying, exploring the surroundings.

lines.zh: 低吟细语，准备出巢觅食。
lines.en: Muttering softly, preparing to forage.

lines.zh: 嗡鸣不息，警惕四周动静。
lines.en: Buzzing constantly, vigilant of surroundings.

lines.zh: 低语呢喃，飘荡在密室中。
lines.en: Whispering softly, drifting through the chambers.

lines.zh: 振翅低叫，警惕潜在威胁。
lines.en: Buzzing low, wary of threats.
Buzzing softly, searching for an exit.
Antennae swaying, sensing danger.
My wing membranes hum through the chamber
I patrol the veins of the hive
I drift past, dragging my brood sac
My feelers brush the wet walls
I leave slime along the flesh walls
I weave between the hive pillars
Floating silently, awaiting orders.
Hanging still, guarding the hive.
Suspended mid-air, gazing afar.
Suspended, waiting for commands.
Hanging still, pondering strategies.
Suspended, evaluating the environment.
Hanging still, monitoring the surroundings.
Suspended, observing the world.
Hanging still, awaiting summons.
Suspended, guarding the hive entrance.
Wings folded, clinging to the ceiling
One breath, and the whole hive breathes

lines.zh: 我脚下的肉毯开始蠕动。
lines.en: The carpet of flesh beneath me stirs.

lines.zh: 整个蜂巢随我的心跳一缩。
lines.en: The whole hive contracts with my heartbeat.
Fixing on the player, issuing a threat.
Observing the player, preparing to attack.
Fixing on the player, warning them.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，威慑附近憎厌群。
lines.en: Fixing on the player, intimidating nearby swarm.
Fixing on the player, instilling fear.
Observing the player, preparing to retaliate.
Fixing on the player, commanding the swarm.
Fixing on the player, preparing to strike.
Your heartbeat woke the hive

lines.zh: 我的复眼把你拆成碎片
lines.en: My compound eyes take you apart
You stand at the hive's center. Good

lines.zh: 触须颤抖着，痛苦地叫喊着。
lines.en: Its tentacles tremble in agony.
A mournful hum.
Its tentacles weakly wave.
Pain rips through its tentacles.

lines.zh: 嗡嗡声中夹杂着痛苦的嘶叫。
lines.en: A strangled hum.

lines.zh: 触须扭曲着，发出痛苦的嘶叫。
lines.en: Its tentacles contort in agony.

lines.zh: 嗡嗡声渐渐低沉，仿佛在痛苦中哀鸣。
lines.en: The hum fades, sounding sad.
Its tentacles tremble, humming in pain.

lines.zh: 它的触须痛苦地颤抖着。
lines.en: Its tentacles tremble painfully.
Its tentacles contort, humming in pain.

lines.zh: 嗡鸣低语，引诱着你靠近，但不要接近！
lines.en: Buzzing whispers, tempting you closer, but don't get near!

lines.zh: 我的触须能感应你的心跳，靠近我会带来死亡！
lines.en: My tentacles feel your heartbeat, coming near will mean death!

lines.zh: 享受我的甜蜜馈赠，但不要触碰我！
lines.en: Savor my sweet offering, but do not touch me!

lines.zh: 你的食物会是我的食物，靠近我会遭殃！
lines.en: Your food will be my food, coming near will bring trouble!

lines.zh: 我比你想象的还要庞大，靠近我你会后悔！
lines.en: I am larger than you think, coming near will bring regret!

lines.zh: 不要尝试驯服我，你会付出代价的！
lines.en: Do not try to tame me, you will pay the price!

lines.zh: 我的触须能感应你，靠近我会让你后悔！
lines.en: My tentacles sense you, coming near will bring regret!

lines.zh: 你的存在威胁着蜂巢，靠近我会付出代价！
lines.en: Your presence threatens the hive, coming near will have consequences!

lines.zh: 我的智慧远超你，靠近我会带来灾难！
lines.en: My wisdom far exceeds yours, coming near will bring disaster!

lines.zh: 不要接近，你的命不久矣！
lines.en: Do not come closer, your life is shortening!

lines.zh: 避开我庞大的身躯，否则会遭到攻击！
lines.en: Avoid my large body, or you will be attacked!

lines.zh: 我的身体阻挡你，远离我会更安全！
lines.en: My body blocks you, staying away is safer!

lines.zh: 试图撞击我，你会后悔莫及！
lines.en: Try to collide with me, you will regret it!

lines.zh: 你的撞击对我无效，远离我会更安全！
lines.en: Your collision is ineffective, stay away from me!

lines.zh: 我的外壳坚硬如石，靠近我会遭殃！
lines.en: My shell is hard as stone, coming near will bring trouble!

lines.zh: 我的触须能感知撞击，小心靠近！
lines.en: My tentacles sense collisions, beware of coming near!

lines.zh: 我的体型庞大，靠近我会带来灾难！
lines.en: My size is immense, coming near will bring disaster!

lines.zh: 避开我的身体，否则会遭受攻击！
lines.en: Avoid my body, or you will be attacked!

lines.zh: 我的外壳坚固，靠近我会遭殃！
lines.en: My armor is tough, coming near will bring trouble!

lines.zh: 不要靠近我，否则会遭受攻击！
lines.en: Do not come close, or you will be attacked!

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，才能延续蜂巢的意志！
lines.en: Find a mate to continue the hive's will!

lines.zh: 与我结合，我们的力量将更加强大！
lines.en: Mate with me, our power will be greater!

lines.zh: 我们的结合，让蜂巢更加强大！
lines.en: Our union strengthens the hive!

lines.zh: 选择我作为伴侣，我们的后代将更加聪明！
lines.en: Choose me as your mate, our offspring will be smarter!

lines.zh: 我们是完美的伴侣，共同守护蜂巢！
lines.en: We are the perfect partners, guarding the hive together!

lines.zh: 与我结合，共同创造更强大的未来！
lines.en: Mate with me, to create a stronger future together!

lines.zh: 选择我作为你的伴侣，我们的力量将更加壮大！
lines.en: Choose me as your mate, our strength will grow!

lines.zh: 我们的结合，将为蜂巢带来新的希望！
lines.en: Our union brings new hope to the hive!

lines.zh: 与我结合，我们的后代将更加聪明、强大！
lines.en: Mate with me, our offspring will be smarter and stronger!

lines.zh: 与我结合，共同守护蜂巢的未来！
lines.en: Mate with me, to safeguard the hive's future!
Buzz like thunder, I am order.
Deep in the hive, I am the wise one.
Hate the Swarm for me.
Eat skulls, taste my power.
Those who die by me, fall into darkness.

lines.zh: 我乃蜂巢之脑，不死之躯。
lines.en: I am Hive's Brain, undying.
Skull Eaters swarm, death comes.
Summoned by me, nowhere to hide.
Hate the Swarm, my protectors.
Hive's will, eternal and unchanging.
Peeker, show yourself.
Your existence, I have noticed.
Hide no more, come to die.
All who invade my hive, shall be slaughtered.
Target locked, prepare to be devoured.
Know thy folly, thou shalt be annihilated.
My will, none can withstand.
Hate the Swarm, obey me.
You have been chosen, die.
My will, none can violate.
Hate the Swarm, obey my command.
Fight for me, or perish.
Hate the Swarm, my servant.
Intrude my hive, die without a grave.
Hate the Swarm, share my fate.
My will, death's command.
Die for me, show your loyalty.
Hate the Swarm, fight for me
Die for me, find freedom.
Hate the Swarm, share my glory.
The hateful swarm crawls from the holes

lines.zh: 我的死会让它们更愤怒
lines.en: My death will only make them angrier
Buzz, then spit venom.
Whip tentacles, I devour you!
Wrap you in tentacles!
Venom eats away at you!
I count the hive's heartbeats.
Tentacles smother you!
You will feed me!
Venom seeps through you!
Tentacles tear your flesh!
Toxin enters, you rot!
Spawn Swarm here!
Spawn Swarm back!
Spawn Swarm reborn!
Death, spawn Swarm!
Return, become Swarm!
Spawn Swarm from me!
Death, Swarm descends!
Souls, become Swarm!
The chamber glows, and I take shape
The flesh wall splits and I push out
The humming gathers into one voice
The hive's heartbeat quickens
Flames consume its tentacles.

lines.zh: 摔落的撞击令它痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: It screeches in pain from the fall.
Its tentacles are drowned.
The explosion rips through its shell.
An arrow pierces its tentacles.
A spell tears through its shell.
Starvation weakens it.
Lightning strikes its tentacles.
Darkness consumes its tentacles.
